theatres.review: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure.

similar.title: Avatar: The Deep Dive - A Special Edition of 20/20

theatres.fullReview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.
